assetBrief:
SUBJECT: volume as packing unit cubes — a clear rectangular prism (4×3×2) packed with visible unit cubes; peel front layer to reveal the base; extend the depth; fill with tinted water.

GEOMETRY: A clear rectangular prism standing on a board, containing 4 × 3 × 2 = 24 small unit cubes with faint outlines. 'Peel' slides the front layer (the front 4×3 slab) forward and down to reveal the 12-cube base layer; 'rebuild' restacks. A depth handle extends one horizontal dimension, re-laying cubes and updating a counter. 'Fill water' pours translucent tinted water to the brim of the prism, level with the top cubes, showing capacity = volume.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) clear box shell; (3) unit cubes; (4) water fill.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front-right, above eye level, frames the prism; labels legible. Budget 8-14k triangles. Named nodes: Board, BoxShell, UnitCubes, FrontLayer, BaseLayer, DepthHandle, WaterFill, CounterTag. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
